render.headline: Accept Bitcoin. Keep dollars.
render.subheadline: Square can convert Bitcoin payments to USD immediately—or let you settle in BTC.

posts.text: Accept Bitcoin. Keep dollars. Eligible Square sellers can take Lightning payments and settle in BTC or have Square convert the payment to USD immediately. Bitcoin payment processing is 0% through Dec. 31, 2026, then 1%. Current limits: $600 per transaction and $20,000 per day; not available in New York. Guide: bitcoin4retail.com/how-square-bitcoin-works.html #Bitcoin #Retail #Square #Payments

Accepting Bitcoin does not mean you have to hold Bitcoin. Eligible Square sellers can take Lightning payments and settle in BTC or USD. 0% processing through Dec. 31, 2026; 1% after. $600 max per transaction; not available in New York. #bitcoin #retail #square #payments
